# The CSS subset

Every list here is rendered from the table the compiler of stylesheets itself reads.

## Properties

A rule declares these properties; the compiler refuses any other.

### Layout

- `display` takes `block`, `flex`, `grid` or `none`
- `position` takes `relative`, `absolute` or `sticky`
- `overflow` takes one or two of `visible`, `hidden`, `auto` and `scroll`
- `overflow-x` takes `visible`, `hidden`, `auto` or `scroll`
- `overflow-y` takes `visible`, `hidden`, `auto` or `scroll`
- `width` takes a length, a percentage, `calc()` or `auto`
- `height` takes a length, a percentage, `calc()` or `auto`
- `min-width` takes a length, a percentage, `calc()` or `auto`
- `min-height` takes a length, a percentage, `calc()` or `auto`
- `max-width` takes a length, a percentage, `calc()` or `none`
- `max-height` takes a length, a percentage, `calc()` or `none`
- `margin` takes one to four lengths, percentages or `auto`
- `margin-top` takes a length, a percentage, `calc()` or `auto`
- `margin-right` takes a length, a percentage, `calc()` or `auto`
- `margin-bottom` takes a length, a percentage, `calc()` or `auto`
- `margin-left` takes a length, a percentage, `calc()` or `auto`
- `padding` takes one to four lengths or percentages, not negative
- `padding-top` takes a length, a percentage or `calc()`, not negative
- `padding-right` takes a length, a percentage or `calc()`, not negative
- `padding-bottom` takes a length, a percentage or `calc()`, not negative
- `padding-left` takes a length, a percentage or `calc()`, not negative
- `inset` takes one to four lengths, percentages or `auto`
- `top` takes a length, a percentage, `calc()` or `auto`
- `right` takes a length, a percentage, `calc()` or `auto`
- `bottom` takes a length, a percentage, `calc()` or `auto`
- `left` takes a length, a percentage, `calc()` or `auto`
- `gap` takes one or two lengths or percentages, not negative
- `row-gap` takes a length, a percentage or `calc()`, not negative
- `column-gap` takes a length, a percentage or `calc()`, not negative

### Flex and alignment

- `flex-direction` takes `row`, `row-reverse`, `column` or `column-reverse`
- `flex-wrap` takes `nowrap`, `wrap` or `wrap-reverse`
- `flex-flow` takes a flex direction, a flex wrap or both
- `flex-grow` takes a number, not negative
- `flex-shrink` takes a number, not negative
- `flex-basis` takes a length, a percentage, `calc()` or `auto`
- `flex` takes `none`, or a grow factor, a shrink factor and a basis
- `justify-content` takes `normal`, `start`, `end`, `flex-start`, `flex-end`, `center`, `stretch`, `space-between`, `space-around` or `space-evenly`
- `align-content` takes `normal`, `start`, `end`, `flex-start`, `flex-end`, `center`, `stretch`, `space-between`, `space-around` or `space-evenly`
- `justify-items` takes `normal`, `start`, `end`, `flex-start`, `flex-end`, `center`, `baseline` or `stretch`
- `align-items` takes `normal`, `start`, `end`, `flex-start`, `flex-end`, `center`, `baseline` or `stretch`
- `justify-self` takes `auto`, `normal`, `start`, `end`, `flex-start`, `flex-end`, `center`, `baseline` or `stretch`
- `align-self` takes `auto`, `normal`, `start`, `end`, `flex-start`, `flex-end`, `center`, `baseline` or `stretch`

### Grid

- `grid-template-columns` takes `none` or a list of track sizes and `repeat()`
- `grid-template-rows` takes `none` or a list of track sizes and `repeat()`
- `grid-auto-columns` takes one or more track sizes
- `grid-auto-rows` takes one or more track sizes
- `grid-auto-flow` takes `row` or `column`, with or without `dense`
- `grid-column` takes a start line and, after `/`, an end line
- `grid-row` takes a start line and, after `/`, an end line
- `grid-column-start` takes `auto`, a line number or `span` with a count
- `grid-column-end` takes `auto`, a line number or `span` with a count
- `grid-row-start` takes `auto`, a line number or `span` with a count
- `grid-row-end` takes `auto`, a line number or `span` with a count

### Border and outline

- `border` takes a width, a style (`solid` or `none`) and a color, in any order
- `border-top` takes a width, a style (`solid` or `none`) and a color, in any order
- `border-right` takes a width, a style (`solid` or `none`) and a color, in any order
- `border-bottom` takes a width, a style (`solid` or `none`) and a color, in any order
- `border-left` takes a width, a style (`solid` or `none`) and a color, in any order
- `border-width` takes one to four lengths, not negative
- `border-style` takes one to four of `solid` and `none`
- `border-color` takes one to four color tokens, `transparent` or `currentColor`
- `border-top-width` takes a length, not negative
- `border-right-width` takes a length, not negative
- `border-bottom-width` takes a length, not negative
- `border-left-width` takes a length, not negative
- `border-top-style` takes `solid` or `none`
- `border-right-style` takes `solid` or `none`
- `border-bottom-style` takes `solid` or `none`
- `border-left-style` takes `solid` or `none`
- `border-top-color` takes a color token, `transparent` or `currentColor`
- `border-right-color` takes a color token, `transparent` or `currentColor`
- `border-bottom-color` takes a color token, `transparent` or `currentColor`
- `border-left-color` takes a color token, `transparent` or `currentColor`
- `border-radius` takes one to four lengths, not negative
- `border-top-left-radius` takes a length, not negative
- `border-top-right-radius` takes a length, not negative
- `border-bottom-right-radius` takes a length, not negative
- `border-bottom-left-radius` takes a length, not negative
- `outline` takes a width, a style (`solid` or `none`) and a color, in any order
- `outline-width` takes a length, not negative
- `outline-style` takes `solid` or `none`
- `outline-color` takes a color token, `transparent` or `currentColor`
- `outline-offset` takes a length

### Paint

- `background` takes `none`, a color, a gradient or both
- `background-color` takes a color token, `transparent` or `currentColor`
- `background-image` takes `none`, `linear-gradient()` or `radial-gradient()`
- `box-shadow` takes `none` or a shadow token
- `color` takes a color token, `transparent` or `currentColor`
- `object-fit` takes `fill`, `contain`, `cover`, `none` or `scale-down`

### Text

- `caret-color` takes `auto`, a color token, `transparent` or `currentColor`
- `font-family` takes a `font-` token
- `font-size` takes a `text-` size token or a `calc()` over one, not negative
- `font-weight` takes `normal`, `bold` or a `text-weight-` token
- `font-style` takes `normal` or `italic`
- `line-height` takes `normal` or a `text-leading` token
- `letter-spacing` takes `normal` or a length
- `text-align` takes `start`, `end`, `left`, `right` or `center`
- `text-decoration` takes `none`, `underline` or `line-through`
- `text-overflow` takes `clip` or `ellipsis`
- `white-space` takes `normal`, `nowrap`, `pre` or `pre-wrap`
- `font-variant-numeric` takes `normal` or `tabular-nums`

### Effects

- `opacity` takes a number or a percentage
- `transform` takes `none` or a list of `translate()`, `scale()`, `rotate()` and their one-axis forms
- `transform-origin` takes one or two lengths, percentages or edge keywords
- `filter` takes `none` or a list of `blur()`, `brightness()`, `contrast()`, `grayscale()`, `saturate()` and `opacity()`
- `backdrop-filter` takes `none` or a list of `blur()`, `brightness()` and `saturate()`
- `mix-blend-mode` takes `normal`, `multiply`, `screen`, `overlay`, `darken` or `lighten`

### Motion

- `transition` takes `none` or a list of transitions, each a property, a duration, an easing and a delay
- `animation` takes `none` or a list of animations, each the name of keyframes, a duration, an easing, a delay, an iteration count, a direction and a fill mode

## States

A selector requires a state of an element with one of these pseudo-classes; the compiler refuses any other.

- `:hover`
- `:active`
- `:focus`
- `:focus-visible`
- `:focus-within`
- `:disabled`
- `:checked`

## Pseudo-elements

A rule of a pseudo-element styles a part of its element and declares only what the pseudo-element takes.

- `::placeholder` takes `color`
- `::selection` takes `background-color`

## Token families

The name of a token opens, after `--`, with the prefix of its family: color-, space-, radius-, font-, text-, shadow-, motion-.
